meta.note: Curated from public sources (brand newsrooms, press coverage, ACSI, Axios Harris Poll 100, YouGov). AI-voice samples and 0-10 attribute ratings (Warmth, Quality, Innovation, Value, Trust) are authentic LLM outputs generated by Claude (Anthropic) on the dates shown, single model, single run. Voice-valence coding (-2..+2, official anchored at +2) is curator-assigned from the cited indices. Replace this file with a live API response of the same shape to make the tracker live - see assets/js/brand-tracker.js.

official.label: Official Voice
official.description: How the brand speaks for itself — campaigns, newsrooms, and executive statements (2024–2026).

consumer.label: Consumer Voice
consumer.description: How consumers rate and talk about the brand — satisfaction and reputation indices plus documented consumer reactions.

ai.label: AI-Generated Voice
ai.description: How an LLM describes and markets the brand — authentic model outputs, labeled with model and date.
